Breaking cosmological degeneracy. Spectroscopic redshift surveys like BOSS, eBOSS, BigBOSS, DESpec, or Euclid will complement LSST dark energy constraints by adding independent cosmological measurements, which break degeneracies. The complementarity is enhanced when the surveys overlap on the sky so that their different trac- ers measure exactly the same density fluctuations (e.g., LSST lensing and galaxy densities, and redshift-survey galaxy density) and permit cross-correlation between the redshift survey and pho- tometric survey data to calibrate photo-z’s.
